item.title: Some local cities in the red after snowiest winter in years
item.description: It's been one of the snowiest winters this area has seen in years, and budget decisions made in the warmer months are leaving communities across the area in the red.

item.title: Public health, green groups sue EPA over repeal of rule supporting climate protections
item.description: A coalition of health and environmental groups sued the Environmental Protection Agency on Wednesday, challenging the rescinding of a scientific finding that has been the central basis for U.S. action to regulate greenhouse gas emissions and fight climate change.

item.title: Honoring Black History: Watch on Friday, Feb. 20
item.description: Watch Honoring Black History this Friday, Feb. 20, at 6:30 p.m. on FOX Providence, the WPRI 12+ smart TV app, and right here on WPRI.com.

item.title: Why Foxboro is threatening to withhold licenses for 2026 FIFA World Cup at Boston Stadium
item.description: The chiefs of the Foxboro police and fire departments have been preparing for roughly three years to ensure everyone attending the 2026 FIFA World Cup has a safe and memorable experience, but town leaders are growing increasingly frustrated over who will cover the public safety costs.

item.title: Man injured in Pawtucket shooting is high school administrator
item.description: The family friend who was critically wounded in the deadly shooting at a Pawtucket ice rink earlier this week is a high school administrator.

item.title: 'Sticks out': RI hockey community showing support after Pawtucket shooting
item.description: Hockey sticks and skates are being left outside on doorsteps as part of "Sticks Out Rhode Island."

item.title: 'Instinct just took over': Man recalls moment he put Pawtucket shooter in headlock
item.description: Bob and Mary Ann Rattenni were at Lynch Arena in Pawtucket on Monday supporting their friend's son in his senior night hockey game.

item.title: Weapons seized from Pawtucket shooter's Maine storage unit
item.description: Authorities have seized two guns and several firearm accessories after a court-authorized search warrant at the Pawtucket shooter's residence and storage unit in Maine.

item.title: Pawtucket rink shooter's son set fire to Black church in North Providence in 2024
item.description: Robert Dorgan's biological son, Kevin Colantonio, was sentenced to over six years in prison for setting fire to Shiloh Gospel Temple in 2024.
